value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there's no open Costco there yet. The one planned at 3471 Wyecroft Rd is slated to open in 2027. The closest open ones I found are the Burlington warehouse at 1225 Brant St and the Laird Rd one in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. I couldn't confirm which of those two is closer to you, and Burlington's listed hours differ from site to site.
